lines.text: As His ascension approached, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem and sent messengers ahead into a Samaritan village.
The Samaritans refused to welcome Jesus, so James and John asked to call down hail from heaven.
Jesus rebuked James and John, and He and His disciples went on to another village.
A man said he would follow Jesus wherever He went, and Jesus said foxes have dens but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
Jesus told a man who wanted to bury his father to go and wait for Him in Jerusalem.
